Map: TNF and IL-1β - p38 MAPK - NaV1.8
Why: TNF and IL-1β sensitise nociceptors through p38
Note: IL-1R1 in TRPV1 nociceptors is enough for OA pain in mice, and an open trial of intra-articular etanercept relieved knee OA pain; but in the meta-analysis of placebo-controlled trials, TNF and IL-1 blockers gave no clinically relevant pain relief in OA.
Evidence: OA model (mouse), small human OA trial, meta-analysis
